name: publicala
description: Public Claude Code plugins by Publica.la.

plugins.name: bonsai
plugins.description: Keeps CLAUDE.md files deliberately small and shaped: intake records verified evidence from PR reviews, feed grows rules from observed patterns, bake converts them into automated checks, guard turns one review round's findings into checks shipped as their own PRs, audit prunes with evidence, split moves rules to the scope that reads them.

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Blueprint, publica.la's house style for engineering visuals: diagram renders figures, spec sheets, social cards and slides to PNG and PDF, and walkthrough makes short silent videos that explain a change, both from small HTML sources with checks that refuse a broken result.
